critical_code_review_comments: NotificationBell.tsx uses new Date() (browser-local) to query /api/appointments?start=today&end=today while send_appointment_reminders() uses Montreal timezone. If the browser is not on America/Montreal, an appointment created for one Montreal-local date may not appear in the bell of a user in another timezone (or vice-versa) for a few hours near midnight. Not a bug for Quebec users but worth documenting.

All 3 iteration-20 features (Nurse Day Panel with position gating, morning appointment reminder pipeline, mileage export with configurable rate + CSV) are fully operational. The Montreal-vs-browser timezone gap in NotificationBell is a minor edge case (near midnight for non-Montreal browsers) worth documenting but not blocking.
